title: Image Prompt Registry record
description: A normalized image-prompt record published under registry schema version 1.

httpUrl.description: An absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL.

id.description: Stable record identifier formed from the source ID and a truncated SHA-256 digest.

prompt.description: Normalized prompt body with LF line endings.

description.description: Optional explanatory text; an empty string means unavailable.

coverUrl.description: Absolute preview-image URL, or an empty string when unavailable.

author.description: Upstream author or attribution label; an empty string means unavailable.

sourceUrl.description: Original record URL, falling back to the source homepage.

createdAt.description: Upstream date as YYYY-MM-DD, an RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, or an empty string.

imageMode.description: Whether the upstream prompt generates a new image, edits an input, or leaves the mode unspecified.

imageModel.description: Opaque upstream model identifier; an empty string means unspecified.

imageSize.description: Optional upstream image size or aspect-ratio label.

imageCount.description: Optional positive requested or produced image count.

examples.title: Editorial product portrait
examples.prompt: Create an editorial product portrait with soft window light.
examples.author: Example Author
